title: May the Fourth be with you, San Diego!
description:
Our first responders may not carry lightsabers, but they are the Jedi protecting San Diego every day.

From keeping the peace to answering the call when it matters most, their force is strong, and our city is safer for it.

May the Fourth be with you, San Diego✨🚒🚓
